rationale.automation-bias: Empirically studies user over-reliance, deskilling, and trust asymmetries in vibe coding.
rationale.quality-debt: Identifies AI code bloat and integration failures degrading maintainability.
rationale.survey-input: Provides substantive empirical findings on enterprise adoption, workflows, and trust.
rationale.agentic: Studies tools like Bolt generating complete functional prototypes and applications.
rationale.assistive: Also studies Cursor and conversational inline code generation.
rationale.non-developer: Studies UX designers and product managers generating and overseeing code.
rationale.risk-overreliance: Focal analysis on pseudo-productivity, skill erosion, and uncritical AI dependence.
rationale.risk-quality: Analyzes code unreliability, scaling breakdowns, and unstructured code accumulation.
rationale.method-self-report: Conducted semi-structured interviews with 22 product team members.
